records.title: Data retention policy exception
records.requested_deviation: Extend retention of user engagement data from 90 to 180 days.
records.business_justification: Longer history needed to identify long-term user behaviour patterns for a new analytics project.
conditions: Role-based access restricted to named Product Analytics personnel with documented need.
All access logged and reviewed bi-weekly by GRC or the designated Data Steward.
PII anonymized or pseudonymized where not needed for the approved analysis.
Legal and Privacy confirm 180-day retention is permissible.
Exception expires after 180 days; any further retention needs new approval.

records.title: Access control policy exception
records.requested_deviation: Temporary administrator-level production access for two engineers.
records.business_justification: Real-time diagnostics for performance degradation in a newly deployed AI model.
conditions: Privileged access limited to the AI model components required for diagnostics.
Access expires automatically after 48 hours through privileged identity management.
All commands, configuration changes and data queries logged in real time and independently reviewed within 24 hours of expiry.
Senior engineer or GRC representative provides second-person oversight; no unsupervised administrator access.
CAB-approved change or emergency-change record in place before access begins.
Rollback plan documented and acknowledged by the Engineering Manager.
Post-access summary of actions, findings and production changes within 24 hours.

records.title: Replace continuous monitoring with weekly manual review
records.requested_deviation: Replace continuous automated model monitoring with structured weekly manual review for 90 days.
records.business_justification: Reduce monitoring overhead and improve deployment pipeline speed.
records.decided_by_role: AI Governance Program Lead and Information Security Steering Committee
resubmission_path: Complete A.6.2 monitoring implementation with current telemetry and alert-threshold evidence.
Close the CC7.1 confidentiality evidence failure.
Complete prompt-injection and adversarial validation for A.8.3 and CC6.3.

provenance.location: pp.6-8 policy exception review and decision record
